body:
Deal: Cuckoo Micom 6-Cup Rice Cooker CR-0685FW $119.99 in-Store or $129.98 Delivered (Was $159.98) @ Costco (Membership Required)

[teereb] Ugh, an really looking for a 316 stainless steel cooking bowl. Ali November special I'll wait for and keep using the $20 Kmart one until then haha
[Tmbao95] Cmon, this is the only non stick Uncle Roger would approve
[Mintee] Soooo apparently cuckoo is the way to goat least that's what i hear…. , how the heck is there 13 pre-set option - obviously I dont know much about cooking rice
[bAps] well if you read the rest of the sentence, it explains it does more than just cook rice
13 preset cooking function (veggie, yogurt, multi grain, brown, white rice etc.)
[Mintee] https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0747/1294/0835/files/25030…
Does more again! …. read through the whole manual.
[bargainhuntr] how does it compare to the Kmart rice cooker, which I can also afford
[frank100] Kmart one you can throw it easily after scratch, and it is almost equivalent to 6-7 of them😁 Kmart one maybe quicker
[NedStark102] What sort of cancerous non stick coating do these use?
[BargainGeezer] Honestly if there’s one thing that’s not too bad to get non-stick, it’s rice cookers. I’d prefer mine to be stainless steel, yes, but also rice cookers just can’t reach the temps that make these chemical dangerous.
I wash mine by hand with a blue chux cloth to avoid any chance of scratching. Still looks new after a few years of low-medium usage.
[gakko] I think actually a lot of non stick is long chain pfas . Short chain is the shit that your body absorbs rather than passes. And is also a byproduct of long chain production.
[lovestorm catcher] Could you please elaborate? I have an induction Tiger which i bought in Japan. My wife has been wanting a Cuckoo stainless steel…
[namtae] Cuckoo make more premium IH/pressure cooking models. This would probably be a downgrade from a Tiger IH.
The higher end Cuckoos are really good however. But if you're solely using for the purpose of white rice (especially short grain), Japanese rice cookers probably edge them for taste (also it tends to come out stickier with the Cuckoos).
R.e. the non-stick coating on the bowl, don't wash/rinse your rice in the rice cooker bowl as that's what's going to wear away the coating. Wash them in another container before pouring the washed rice into the rice cooker bowl.
[woolly] I own one of these and only used it for a few months now put it away planning to sell it, the controls are way too confusing and just not very good, not really intuitive at all. Better off buying a Zojirushi next time Everyday Market has a good % cashback. This particular model of Cuckoo I would say is the worst of all time due to it's bad controls. Kmart would honestly be better. This one it's hard to set the mode, easy to leave it on keep warm - it's just a pain.
[johnnytran] How’s the rice? It’s been a while since I looked into rice cookers but from memory cuckoo makes the rice stickier, not fluffy like other brands
[Hitokage] As someone that eats rice everyday, Cuckoo's rice just doesn't taste as nice as the Japanese rice cookers.
Reverted back to the 10 year old Zojirushi I borrowed from folks after briefly using a Cuckoo induction one.
FYI, this Cuckoo also made in China for those that care.
[Lancerx] Just worth checking out the stainless steel only pot. Those non stick ones are scary after the coating worn off if you think about it.
[T-man] This or Xiaomi Mijia Multifunctional IH Rice Cooker?
[shutuptakemymoney101] China vs Japan? Xiaomi is another Chinese rice cooker, probably cooks towards the Chinese ideal for rice which is fine if that is your thing.
[Kaise] These cuckoos are made in China and not near the quality of the old ones from Costco that are made in Korea
